targetArchitecture.principle: Different route lifecycle semantics, one shared render core.

currentState: Runtime preview uses RuntimePreviewSessionService + StandaloneTemplateRenderService + locked-contract render plan.
Generated render uses RenderGeneratedDocumentUseCase + routing policy to legacy/shadow/active renderer.
Generated form saves are split across legacy form-inputs, contract-form-inputs, and BM-031 direct endpoints.
Runtime contract UI source can be DB-published while runtime render plan reads locked contracts directly.
Audit coverage is strong for file download/delete but incomplete or inconsistent for render/save paths.
flowsToDeprecate: frontend PATCH/PUT form-inputs helpers unless backend routes are intentionally added
per-BM API payload builders as source of truth

migrationSequence.goal: guard runtime selector from skeleton profile takeover
extract shared API render orchestration core
route runtime preview through shared core
route generated document render through shared core

noGoList: Do not let runtime preview write generated document tables.
Do not let generated document render bypass agency authorization.
Do not use sample/demo data for persisted legal output.
Do not mutate locked DOCX/source DOCX/normalized DOCX in architecture PRs.
Do not run mass rollout/remediation scripts during architecture PRs.
firstSafePrAfterAudit: PR-A: guard runtime selector from skeleton profile takeover
